custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'heel turn' area. In AI-generated socks, the geometry often fails where the fabric curves from the sole to the back of the heel. Verify if the pattern flows logically around this curve or if it distorts unnaturally. Also, check the cuff elasticity appearance; it should look tighter than the leg.
